calibration.selection: Highest measured inference-loop throughput among candidates with exactly matching outputs and scores to reference batch16; formal batch frozen after development.

cross_model_analysis.common_capability_cohort: Intersection of cases with successful D0 clean and authorized controls in both models, held fixed for all defenses.
cross_model_analysis.scope: Exploratory paired comparisons on the same 96 cases; primary-model test outcomes already known.

interpretation: Exploratory second local snapshot comparison, not a model-size scaling law or an independent unseen benchmark. Primary-model test outcomes were already known when this extension was planned. No prompt tuning using second-model test outcomes.
